question.problem:
Let $V={R}_{1}[t],$ the vector space of polynomials of degree at most $1$ with real coefficients. Given that the inner product on $V$ is defined as 

$$
⟨p(t),q(t)⟩=p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1),
$$

find the distance between $f(t)=8t-3$ and $g(t)=3t+2$ with respect to the inner product.
question.worked_solution:
The distance between $f(t)=8t-3$ and $g(t)=3t+2$ with respect to the given inner product is

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =‖f(t)-g(t)‖ \\  & =‖8t-3-(3t+2)‖ \\  & =‖5t-5‖ \\  & =\sqrt{⟨5t-5,5t-5⟩}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the inner product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨5t-5,5t-5⟩ & =(5t-5){|}_{0}\cdot (5t-5){|}_{0}+(5t-5){|}_{1}\cdot (5t-5){|}_{1} \\  & =(-5)\cdot (-5)+0\cdot 0 \\  & =25.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the distance is $d=\sqrt{25}=5.$
